Introduction.SourceString: 人狠话不多的保镖小姐——「伊波恩」专职。
Introduction.LocalizedString: A ruthless bodyguard of few words, working exclusively for Eibon.

Content.SourceString:
伊波恩古董店的保镖小姐不怎么说话，总是很安静地站在众人边上。她似乎有个别名叫「小水仙」，浔偶尔这么喊她——她便移开目光，连耳尖都红了个透。至于其他人……如果不想被切成碎段的话，大可以试试这个称呼。

达芙蒂尔有许多眼罩，虽然现在戴得少了，却依然保留了收藏的习惯。说起来，有0个人能看出那些眼罩的区别，但她十分坚信自己这方面的品味。皮质的、暗纹的、走线尤其整洁的……她认真地将它们分门别类，放入自己的小小收藏箱。

达芙蒂尔的弱视眼疾并非天生，而是异能代偿。19岁那年，残酷的真相如万花筒般闯入她的眼瞳，从此她可以透过异象不限时空地看到层层本质。有时候，窥见真相并不是什么好事。关于父母的死因、关于自己一厢情愿的情感寄托、关于「需要」与「被需要」……她失去了一直赖以生存的信仰。绘本里披着红布的英雄沉默将刀刃对准了「母亲」，对准了——那颗曾虚伪地给予过她温暖、跳动的、可恨的心脏。如果复仇女神要因此降责于她……那就来吧。

「小水仙」渴望去往一个快乐美好的地方，于是意外踏上一场充满隐喻的旅途。
——那么， 故事的结局呢？
迄今为止被谎言所垄断，无人所需的人生……没有什么继续下去的必要了。本是这样想着的达芙蒂尔，遇到了一个有些醉意的女人。女人说湖心长着一朵水仙，孤傲得很，似乎谁都摘不走它。自己当然也「需要」那朵花，但是并不会去摘它。
奇怪的女人和奇怪的花。那朵水仙有什么必须独自长在那里的理由吗？一定也是依附于什么，寄托在他人的「需要」上才那样长的吧。起风时，达芙蒂尔听到了与以往不同的枝叶摩挲声。

不妨跟她走，在往后的人生中去追寻答案好了。
Content.LocalizedString:
The bodyguard at Eibon Antique Shop does not say much, always standing quietly beside everyone else. She seems to have a nickname, "Daff," which Hotori occasionally calls her. Whenever Hotori calls her that, Daffodill looks away, her ears turning completely red. As for the others… if they want to be cut to pieces, they are welcome to try using that name.

Daffodill owns many eyepatches. Though she wears them less now, she still keeps up her collecting habit. Nobody can tell the difference between those eyepatches, but she firmly believes in her taste. Leather ones, patterned ones, ones with especially neat stitching… she carefully sorts them by category and places them in her small collection box.

Daffodill was not born with poor vision; rather, it was the price of her Esper Ability. At nineteen, cruel truth burst into her eyes like a kaleidoscope, and since then she could see through anomalies to perceive layers of essence across time and space. Sometimes, glimpsing the truth is not a good thing. She learned about her parents' cause of death, about her own wishful emotional attachments, about needing and being needed… and lost the faith she had relied on for survival. The red-cloaked hero in the picture book silently turned her blade toward Mother, toward that hateful, beating heart that had once falsely given her warmth. If the goddess of vengeance wanted to punish her for this… then so be it.

Daff longed for a happy, beautiful place, and so accidentally embarked on a journey full of metaphors.
So then, what about the ending of the story?
Her life until now was one monopolized by lies. It was a life in which no one needed her… there was no point in continuing. That was what Daffodill had been thinking when she met that slightly tipsy woman. The woman talked about a daffodil growing in the center of the lake, proud and aloof, seemingly impossible for anyone to pick. She naturally needed that flower too, but would not pick it.
A strange woman and a strange flower. What reason did that daffodil have for growing alone there? It must depend on something. Surely it grew that way because it was rooted in others' need for it. When the wind rose, Daffodill heard a different sound of rustling leaves than before.

Why not follow the woman and seek answers in the life ahead?

Content.SourceString:
她推门进去，锈红色的海攀上足底，眩晕感接踵而至，如同一眼望进万花筒。
这时，有一双戴着红手套的手遮住她的眼。
正巧登门拜访的T女士和她一起目睹了父母的惨剧，心痛之余，她提出可以收养达芙蒂尔作为养女。漂亮的女孩失去了双亲，也没有其他亲人冒着被牵连的风险接受丧门之子——她向来是不被「需要」的那个。只有T女士对她伸出手，所以她心怀感激地来到T女士身边。
Content.LocalizedString:
She pushed the door open and went inside. The rust-red sea climbed up to her feet and dizziness soon followed, like staring into a kaleidoscope.
At that moment, a pair of hands wearing red gloves covered her eyes.
Ms. T, who happened to be visiting, witnessed the tragedy of her parents alongside her. In her heartbreak, she offered to adopt Daffodill as her daughter. The beautiful girl had lost both parents, and no other relatives would risk being implicated by taking in a child of misfortune… She had always been the one who was not needed. Only Ms. T reached out her hand to her, so she gratefully took her place by Ms. T's side.

Content.SourceString:
试炼很残酷。即便达芙蒂尔是一个天赋极佳的孩子，也依然会遍体鳞伤。
T女士说，比起其他孩子，她更能感受到与死亡近似的痛苦，某个层面上她就能离父母近一些，她所受的伤也比任何人都更有价值。
而且，T女士「需要她」。
达芙蒂尔不喜欢疼痛，但T女士的话给了她一个「痛苦的理由」。她逼迫自己相信，并将之奉为真理，虔诚地投入试炼。等她准备好后，她就成为T女士的刀刃，游走于各类灰色任务中。
Content.LocalizedString:
The trials were cruel. Even though Daffodill was an exceptionally talented child, she still ended up covered in wounds.
Madam T said that, compared to other children, Daffodill could feel pain closer to death itself, and on some level that brought her closer to her parents. The injuries she suffered were more valuable than anyone else's.
Besides, Madam T needed her.
Daffodill did not like pain, but Madam T's words gave her a reason to suffer. She forced herself to believe in Madam T and held her words as truth, devoutly throwing herself into the trials. Once she was ready, she became Madam T's blade, moving through various gray area missions.

Content.SourceString:
「妈妈，慈善家都是这样的吗？好像故事里披着羊皮的狼。」
「人都是有很多面的。光照越强烈，影子越黑，这才是真实的世界呀。」
「她们……她们经常哭。她们希望妈妈不要让她们这么痛。」
「我的『花朵们』没有任何人可以依靠，只有我。我愿意供给养分，要求的回馈仅仅是筛选出存活最久、绽放最美的那朵花……这是世上最合理不过的事。」
「况且……哭泣总是暂时的。傻孩子，她们现在不是在笑吗？」
于是达芙蒂尔抬起头，看到女孩们笑成一团，簇拥在T女士和自己身边——就像拥着她们真心爱着的母亲。
Content.LocalizedString:
"Mother, are all charities like this? Like wolves in sheep's clothing from the stories?"
"People have many sides. The brighter the light shines, the darker the shadow becomes. That is the real world."
"They… they cry so often. They wish Mother would not make them hurt so much."
"My flowers have no one to depend on except me. I am willing to provide nourishment, and all I ask in return is to select the one that survives longest and blooms most beautifully… it's only reasonable."
"Besides… crying is only temporary. Look at them, silly child. Are they not smiling now?"
Daffodill looked up and saw the girls laughing together, clustering around Madam T and herself, as if they were embracing a mother they truly loved.

Content.SourceString:
她们会一同在T女士的双膝小憩，一左一右。
临睡前互相为对方清洁当日试炼或任务留下的伤口，像两只互相舔舐的小兽。
只是，她偶尔会想——自己与残虹一样吗？不抗拒试炼与任务，代表她在享受吗？
不……她只是享受「被需要」的感觉，再从那被需要的余温中，幻想与父母的依存。
Content.LocalizedString:
They would rest together on Madam T's lap, one on each side.
Before sleep, they would clean each other's wounds from the day's trials or quests, like two small animals grooming one another.
But sometimes she would wonder… was she the same as Zankou? Did not resisting the trials and quests mean she was enjoying them?
No. What she enjoyed was the feeling of being needed, and from that lingering warmth, her thoughts drifted towards parental dependence…

Content.SourceString:
行径不一、线条略微断触的墙痕；与书架相隔微妙的3毫米、倾斜角度有着3°左右的差分……这里有一道暗门。她的眼力一向很好，所以比寻常人更容易抵达真相。庞大壮观、密密麻麻的信息资料，其中包含达芙蒂尔和其父母的个人档案。
详尽到令人汗毛倒立。
她看到自己的照片旁潦草地写着一些批注——「漂亮的藏品」、「任务必需的工具」。
Content.LocalizedString:
Inconsistent patterns, wall marks with slightly broken lines, a subtle 3-millimeter gap from the bookshelf, a tilt angle differing by about 3 degrees… there was surely a hidden door here. Her eyesight had always been sharp, so she could perceive the truth more easily than most. She could see massive, spectacular, densely packed information files, including personal records of Daffodill and her parents.
They were detailed enough to make one's hair stand on end.
She saw scribbled notes beside her own photo: "beautiful collectible," "important tool for missions."

Content.SourceString:
以刚出生的达芙蒂尔作为要挟，父母在T女士的要求下常年外出寻宝。
终于有一天，他们无法再忍受。
「就算带着女儿颠沛流离，也要告诉她真相……一家人必须在一起。」
然而掌控者监视着一切。达芙蒂尔已经到了适宜「开花」的年纪，这对猎人夫妇也找到了她想要的东西。充满异心的棋子已经没有利用价值——除掉就好。
Content.LocalizedString:
Using newborn Daffodill as leverage, Madam T forced Daffodill's parents to spend years away treasure hunting.
Finally, one day, they could no longer bear it.
"Even if we're forced to wander with our daughter, we must tell her the truth… a family must stay together."
However, the controller was watching everything. Daffodill had reached the right age to bloom, and the hunter couple had done all that she wanted. Rebellious pawns were useless. Better eliminate them.

Content.SourceString:
她从不知道湖心长着水仙——小时候并未见过。难道是在她被T女士带走后长出来的？
女人笑了笑，举起了酒壶邀请她干杯。达芙蒂尔看着对方摇摇晃晃的、无所谓的样子，没来由地有些生气。
「我已经失去了一切。请问是要我为了什么而干杯呢？」
「干杯也需要理由吗？嗯……那就……敬一无所有的绝境，敬未曾目睹的天色。再敬这湖心独一无二的水仙。」
「……你也想摘走那朵花吗？」
「嗯……我需要那朵花。但我不会去摘它。」
迎着达芙蒂尔明显在说「自相矛盾」的眼神，女人用湿漉漉的伞尖点了点她的额头。
「谁规定需要某物就必须拿走它？我只是需要它『存在』，能让我像这样一边喝着美酒一边欣赏它，就很满足了呀。」
起风的时候，她听到了和以往不同的枝叶摩挲声。
或许……湖心真的长着一朵水仙。
Content.LocalizedString:
She had never known that a daffodil grew in the center of the lake. She had never seen it as a child. Had it grown after Ms. T took her away?
The woman smiled and raised her wine bottle, inviting her to toast. Daffodill looked at her swaying, carefree manner and felt inexplicably angry.
"I have already lost everything. What exactly am I supposed to toast to?"
"Do toasts need reasons? Well… then… to the despair of having nothing, to skies never witnessed. And to the one and only daffodil in the center of this lake."
"…Do you want to pick that flower too?"
"Mmm… I need that flower. But I will not pick it."
Meeting Daffodill's look that clearly said this was contradictory, the woman tapped her forehead with the wet tip of her umbrella.
"Who decided that needing something means you must take it? I only need it to exist, so I can drink something fine while admiring it like this. That is enough for me."
When the wind rose, she heard a different sound of rustling leaves than before.
Perhaps… there really was a daffodil growing in the center of the lake.

Content.SourceString: 你好，我是达芙蒂尔，浔的保镖……太简单了吗？抱歉，我并不擅长闲聊，有需要请直接咨询「伊波恩」古董店。
Content.LocalizedString: Hello, I'm Daffodill, Hotori's bodyguard… Too simple? Sorry, small talk isn't my strong suit. If you need anything, just reach out to Eibon, the antique shop.

Content.SourceString: 找点事情做做吧，总是闲着的话身体会生锈的。
Content.LocalizedString: You need to do something. Sitting idle won't do your body any good.

Content.SourceString: 再好的武器也需要定期保养才能保持锋利，人也是一样。
Content.LocalizedString: Even the best weapons need regular maintenance to stay sharp, and so do people.

Content.SourceString: 亲、亲爱的顾客，欢迎光……光……啧。

Content.LocalizedString: Good weather. Time for some outdoor training.

Content.SourceString: 下雨了？利用雨水隐蔽身形和气味的话……
Content.LocalizedString: It's raining? I can use rain to mask my presence…

Content.SourceString: 寒冷会让身体僵硬，麻痹感知……或许这时候，猎物和猎手的身份正适合互换。
Content.LocalizedString: The cold stiffens the body and numbs the senses… In such a moment, perhaps it's best for the roles of prey and hunter to be reversed.

Content.SourceString: 早上好，今天的安排是什么？
Content.LocalizedString: Good morning, what's the plan for today?

Content.SourceString: 困的话可以小憩一会儿，我会叫醒你的。
Content.LocalizedString: If you're tired, you can take a nap. I'll wake you up.

Content.SourceString: 还能再训练一会儿，要来么？
Content.LocalizedString: We can train a bit more. Want to join?

Content.SourceString: 好好休息吧，夜里的伊波恩，很安全。
Content.LocalizedString: Rest well, Eibon is safe at night.

Content.SourceString: 谈不上有什么特别喜好，生存需要而已。压缩甜食便于携带又可以提供大量能量，所以我会带上一些以备不时之需。至于口味，那并不重要。
Content.LocalizedString: I can't say I have any particular preferences, just survival needs. Compressed sweets are easy to carry and provide a lot of energy, so I bring some just in case. How they taste doesn't really matter.

Content.SourceString: 有些客人比异象还要难缠，但是浔说为了伊波恩的生意，一定要保持微笑服务……感觉最近的委托成交率更低了？咳……是你的错觉。
Content.LocalizedString: Some customers are harder to deal with than anomalies, but Hotori says we should always smile for Eibon's business… Huh? You think our commission success rate has been dropping lately? Ahem… that's absolutely not true.

Content.SourceString: 真相往往以谎言作为伪装。异象也好，人也好——大多都是表里不一的。光是「看见」远远不够。认知、觉察、剖析。事物像万花筒般从不同视角展开……才能窥见本质。
Content.LocalizedString: Truth often hides among lies. Both humans and anomalies are not what they seem on the surface. Merely "seeing" does not suffice. You must understand, perceive, and analyze. Only when you adopt a kaleidoscope of perspectives… can you fathom truth itself.

Content.SourceString: 日复一日的训练算不上枯燥，想要变得更强，总得付出一些代价。只有足够强大，才不会重蹈覆辙。
Content.LocalizedString: I don't find all the daily training tedious. No pain, no gain, right? The only way to avoid screwing up again is by getting stronger.

Content.SourceString: 我观察过那些坐在岸边一整天却毫无收获的钓者，天气，水温，鱼群状态，太多不可控制的因素都会导致失败，但耐心始终是一个好的猎手该具备的品质，鱼桶总会有装满的时候。
Content.LocalizedString: I've observed those anglers who sit by the shore all day with nothing to show for it. The weather, water temperature, conditions of the fish—so many uncontrollable factors can lead to failure. But patience is always a quality a good hunter should have. Your bucket is going to end up full eventually.

Content.SourceString: 只是用一小部分视力作为交换而已，并不影响日常生活，正相反，有时听见的可比看见的更多。
Content.LocalizedString: Just a trade with some of my vision, doesn't affect my daily life too much. Sometimes you hear more than you see.

Content.SourceString: 总是穿深色的衣服？……并不是什么偏好，只是深色的衣服能掩盖受伤的痕迹，多数时候可以用来欺骗对手。
Content.LocalizedString: Wondering why I wear dark clothes all the time…? It's not because I like them, but because they do a better job at hiding my injuries and deceiving my enemies.

Content.SourceString: 似乎是水仙花的意思。一根枝条上只开一朵，听浔说我家附近的湖心也长着一朵，但我并未见过。如果可以的话，希望你还是喊我「达芙蒂尔」，而不是……嗯。
Content.LocalizedString: It seems to mean "narcissus." Only one flower blooms on each stem. Hotori told me there's one in the lake near my place, though I've never seen it. If possible, I'd prefer you to call me Daffodill instead of…ahem.

Content.SourceString: 有时候浔的做法过于大胆了，总是以身涉险，就好像只要能达成想要的结果，什么都无所谓，呼……是我还不够强。
Content.LocalizedString: I know Hotori will do whatever it takes to get what she wants, putting herself at risk along the way. But sometimes the way she goes about it is a bit over-the-top… Well, I guess I do have some catching up to do.

Content.SourceString: 初遇时就醉醺醺的，那时只觉得是个奇怪的女人。但不知为何……莫名有种安心与信任感。这也是为什么我会在这吧。
Content.LocalizedString: She was drunk when we first met. I just thought she was a strange woman. But for some reason… her presence was comforting and I trusted her. I guess that explains why I'm here now.

Content.SourceString: 那孩子总是在我训练的时候偷偷观察，就算被发现了过一会儿又会藏到另一个地方继续看……算了，只要不妨碍我，就随她吧。
Content.LocalizedString: That kid's always peeking at me when I train. I've caught her a few times, but she just finds another spot and keeps at it… Well, as long as she doesn't get in my way, I guess.

Content.SourceString: 很危险，如非必要，不要和她有任何接触。
Content.LocalizedString: She's very dangerous. Avoid any contact with her unless necessary.

Content.SourceString: 阿德勒先生是非常值得尊敬的人，在我遇到浔之前，是他一直陪伴着浔，我还有很多方面要向他学习。
Content.LocalizedString: Adler is a very respectable person. Before I met Hotori, he was always by her side. I have a lot to learn from him.

Content.SourceString: 伊波恩与我过去所待的地方完全不同。在这里要为了生计去接待难搞的顾客，就连同伴也整天吵吵闹闹……但是……至少在伊波恩里可以睡个安稳觉。
Content.LocalizedString: Eibon is completely different from where I used to be. Here, you have to deal with difficult customers for a living, and your friends here are noisy all the time… but I can sleep here without worrying about anything at least.

Content.SourceString: 这样就能更好地守护了吧。
Content.LocalizedString: This way, your safety is guaranteed.

Content.SourceString: 我应该从未和你说过……我很喜欢，谢谢你。
Content.LocalizedString: I don't think I've told you, but I… like it a lot. Thank you.

Content.SourceString: 这对我来说很珍贵。多谢。
Content.LocalizedString: This is precious for me. Many thanks.

Content.SourceString: 浔说，朋友的礼物大大方方地收下就好。那我就……不客气了。
Content.LocalizedString: Hotori told me I should gladly receive gifts from a friend. I shall receive it… gladly.
What you see is an illusion!

Content.SourceString: 需要我护送到异象管理局吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Need an escort to the Bureau?
Let's take it back to Eibon.

Content.SourceString: 如果这副残躯仍有价值……
Content.LocalizedString: If I can be of any value…

Content.SourceString: 我会让你为自己的行为后悔。

Content.LocalizedString: I'm going to take you back.

Content.SourceString: 你已经很努力了，剩下的交给我。
Content.LocalizedString: You did your best, leave the rest to me.
Looks like you still need me.
You don't know how to give up.
